name: AstroNova, Inc.
old_description: Michael J. Natalizia holds responsibility for overseeing all technology initiatives of the company. As an Executive Corporate Officer, he manages the research and development groups for all AstroNova business groups and leads their technological development. Mr. Natalizia has been with AstroNova since 1986 and has previously served as R&D Manager of the AstroNova Aerospace products, as R&D Manager of AstroNova Product Identification brands and as an engineer in the Test & Measurement products. He earned a Bachelor of Science degree in electrical engineering and computer science from Tufts University.
about:
AstroNova, Inc. is headquartered in West Warwick, Rhode Island. The company operates as a publicly traded corporation (Nasdaq: ALOT) and has been ISO 9001-certified since 1993, adding AS9100 certification in 2009 and FAA Part 145 repair station approval. While the exact founding year is not disclosed, the business has evolved into a global provider of data visualization technologies.

AstroNova designs, manufactures, distributes, and services specialized print technology and data acquisition systems. Its Aerospace segment produces ruggedized flight deck printers, networking hardware, and aerospace-grade supplies for commercial, business, and military aircraft. The Product Identification segment delivers end-to-end digital labeling solutions—including hardware, software, and consumables—for printing on paper, labels, paperboard, corrugated boxes, and bags. The Test & Measurement group supplies high-performance data acquisition systems used in structural testing, power monitoring, transportation validation, and industrial process optimization.

The company serves commercial aviation, business aviation, and military defense markets through its Aerospace division. Product Identification customers span life sciences, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, industrial manufacturing, food and beverage, and cosmetics. Test & Measurement systems are deployed in aerospace and defense, power and utilities, transportation, automotive, and general industrial applications. Customers include OEMs, commercial printers, brand owners, airlines, and defense contractors.

AstroNova emphasizes innovation, responsiveness, and technical support as its competitive edge. A passionate commitment to quality drives zero-defect manufacturing and continuous improvement, underpinned by compliance with ISO, AS9100, FAA, RoHS, WEEE, and REACH standards.
